items.title: Serre's condition S_k ascends along a flat map with S_k fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that Serre's condition S_k ascends along a flat map of Noetherian rings whose fibre rings satisfy S_k, provided the base does (statement lines 46619-46630). The proof does not reprove the depth formula: it invokes the comparison of depth with the fibre and the base, then estimates the dimension of the localised ring from the two parts and applies the two hypotheses to obtain the required inequality (proof lines 46632-46674). Deciding how to split both depth and dimension between the fibre and the base is the content. H2.
